description.zh:
容器字段。取值：

- **clusterId**：集群编号
description.en:
The container field. Valid values:

- **clusterId**: cluster ID.
The value of the container field.

description.zh: 请求来源标识，固定为**sas**，表示请求来源为云安全中心。
description.en: The source of the request. Set the value to **sas**, which indicates that the request is sent from Security Center.

description.zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：

- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

description.zh:
多账号查询类型。默认值为**0**。取值：
- **0**：查询当前账号数据
- **1**：查询所有账号数据
description.en:
The multi-account query type. Default value: **0**. Valid values:
- **0**: queries data of the current account.
- **1**: queries data of all accounts.
The name of the security alerting Alarm Metric.
The IP address of the access source.

description.zh: 告警支持的操作类型列表。
description.en: The list of operation types supported by the alert.

description.zh:
指定服务器的UUID。存在多个UUID时使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
> 调用[DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~141932~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The UUIDs of the servers. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,).
> Call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~141932~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-nsas-susp-event-type --source-ip 180.212.XX.XX --remark testECS --name Unusual_Logon --lang zh --from sas --uuids f56406cb-916d-42db-b6f7-2ff79e340000 --container-field-name clusterId --container-field-value ca3108551c83c4d949106e1ab9e1e0000 --multi-account-action-type 0 --support-operate-code-list AI.real_attack --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas DescribeNsasSuspEventType --region cn-hangzhou --SourceIp '180.212.XX.XX' --ContainerFieldName clusterId --ContainerFieldValue ca3108551c83c4d949106e1ab9e1e0000 --Lang zh --From sas --Uuids 'f56406cb-916d-42db-b6f7-2ff79e340000' --SupportOperateCodeList.1 'AI.real_attack' --Remark testECS --Name Unusual_Logon --MultiAccountActionType 0
